state_contract: Host config and catalog_path; fresh owner/window-bound login_required evidence names the original slot and manual login action, even while the pool health is stale. Stale evidence stays unobserved. Rendering never clears account or user pause gates; identity, receipt and source-hash protections remain.
import_side_effects: No new service/browser/model starts; capabilities preserve their original explicit call side effects
compatibility: New projects use canonical packages and public APIs; existing resident entries are served only by pipeline adapters
side_effects: 读取状态及用户明确按按钮后的控制/启动；读取本身不恢复暂停。 一级标签按钮单独调用literature.background CLI，不触及四队/网页/模型。
selection_and_retention: 保留原生面板及固定构建位置，当前运行实例依赖这些接口。状态读取只显示真实任务与观测，控制交给core；不把预留页或缓存busy当作实际生成。
runtime_activation: No automatic start/resume; existing controls and sole owner remain authoritative
manual_seed_trials: cards.api.seed_trials__status reads enrolled original-root progress and actual saved review scores; first priority is a label, never a numeric quality score.
formula_window: 公式整理行的可选 formulaSlots 给出固定 20 页、当前状态、独立图片异常、已核实批号及最近观测时间。
formula_pilot: 已登记的临时聊天测试显示独立开关、状态和未发送重试；调用 oled_formulas start|pause。
literature_level2: Read-only registered paper · 二级标签 row; actual8-process count, admitted-original completed/matched/undetermined, pending/failed/waiting-original/blocked. Dedicated CLI pause/start only; no other workflow or HTTP activation.
formula_app: formulaApp uses Codex Web GPT health, observed native window numbers and app queue counts. formulaAppWindows contains the registered task-tab count and independently observed tab IDs, stages and Shanghai event times. Missing observations are explicit.
